The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''25,818 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''10,645 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, [[Lanoree Brock]] was born on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], and [[Je'daii Master]] [[Dam-Powl]] began teaching at [[Anil Kesh]].<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
